title: Vaishnavism Saints Guru Ghasidas
definition: Guru Ghasidas was a 19th-century social reformer and spiritual leader from Chhattisgarh who founded the Satnami sect, emphasizing monotheism, social equality, and the rejection of the caste system, often contextualized within the broader Bhakti tradition's egalitarian ethos.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests regional socio-religious reform movements that challenged the caste hierarchy. Guru Ghasidas is critical for understanding the 'Bhakti-reformist' continuum in Central India and the evolution of subaltern movements.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Guru Ghasidas.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
